coverage_boundary: The linkage digest covers the six probed symbol/dynamic/relocation surfaces, not every byte of the image: a mutation confined to the ELF section header table leaves all six outputs unchanged. Whole-file byte identity is therefore carried separately by sha256(or_title_runtime_v1.so) above, and the two checks are complementary rather than interchangeable. This boundary was found by the negative control, which failed as originally written.
